lines.en: My four short legs carry me along.
My tail is held high.
The white stripe on my back is clear.
I poke my nose into the grass.
I pass along the stone.
Short legs, small steps, but each one lands true

lines.zh: 我挑阴凉处走，白纹不显眼
lines.en: I keep to the shade so my stripe shows less
I stop and glance at you.
I step over the log.
I keep my head down for sweet berries.
My claws click softly.
My pads settle on the grass without a sound
I settle down to sit.
My ears twitched twice.
The wind comes out of the woods.
My lids sink and lift again
It is comfortable here.
One forepaw hovers while I pick a spot
I am listening to the insects.
My tail has not come down.
I lick along my forepaw.

lines.zh: 这条小径我走过上百回
lines.en: I have walked this little path a hundred times

lines.zh: 留出一臂，我鼻子才舒服
lines.en: Keep an arm's length and my nose is easy

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟沾着泥，我看清了
lines.en: There's mud on your heel, I can see it clear

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经立起来了。
lines.en: My tail is up already.

lines.zh: 你袖口沾着铁锈和烟灰
lines.en: Rust and soot cling to your cuff
If you reach out, I must be careful.
I back into the grass.
Some distance between us is best.

lines.zh: 我不咬人，只有一种办法。
lines.en: I do not bite. I have one other way.
Do not make me turn around.
I lift a forepaw.

lines.zh: 你得蹲下来，我才看得清
lines.en: You would have to crouch for me to see you clearly

lines.zh: 屁股落地，尾巴卷在身侧
lines.en: I sit and curl my tail along my flank
Keep staring and I will leave.
I am not angry yet.
I startled.
I swing my head around at you.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我尾巴先炸开
lines.en: One hit and my tail flares out
I dive into the grass with only my tail showing
That one went deep.
I gave two shakes.
I am still angry.
My tail is still up.
I stamp again.
I arch my back.
Sweet berries? Bring them.
This is what I wait for.
I edge over in tiny steps.
Set it down and step away, then I will come

lines.zh: 鼻尖一动，甜味钻进来了
lines.en: My nose twitches, the sweetness drifts in
I know this stuff.
I am taking it.
One more berry.
I will cache this one first.
Do not tease me with your hand.
I bump you with my snout.
You were nudged half a step.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我浑身毛都扎手
lines.en: One touch and all my fur turns prickly
We brush past and I skip half a step away
I was knocked crooked.
I steady at once.
The grass is trampled.
Do not follow.
I am turning my back on you.
I am about to turn.
There are others of my kind about.
You smell right.
Let us look for berries together.
I will show you that patch.
There are berries enough.
Do not rush me.
This den is warm enough.
Come along with me.
It is safer deeper in the woods.
We will come out at night.
I pick it up in my mouth.
This one is not very sweet.
I scratch a shallow pit and cover it with soil

lines.zh: 我啃掉半边，汁水沾了嘴
lines.en: I gnaw off half, juice on my muzzle
Too hard to bite, the shell is thick
I sniffed what fell.
This is not a berry.
I hide it under the roots.
I keep it as a snack.
I push it with my nose.
Your foot moved.
I turn my rear toward you.
My tail is already up.
I stamp a forepaw.
This is your warning.
My body has gone taut.
Do not come any closer.
I am ready to spray.
Back off a little.
I count to the third.
Three counted.

lines.zh: 第二下，草地都震了一下
lines.en: Second stomp, the grass shudders

lines.zh: 跺一下，你还有两次机会
lines.en: One stomp, you get two more chances

lines.zh: 尾巴立着就是最后通牒
lines.en: My raised tail is the final notice
I have sprayed.
I keep my back to you.
One step closer and it goes higher.
My tail twitched.
I shift my weight forward.

lines.zh: 那只手再往前，我就不客气
lines.en: One more inch with that hand and I am done warning
I am counting your feet.

lines.zh: 侧面也躲不开，我尾巴长
lines.en: The side will not save you, my tail is long
I can turn faster than you.
I set my hind legs.
One step nearer.

lines.zh: 尾巴一颤，是最后的提醒
lines.en: One flick of my tail is the last warning
Do not try it.
Hind legs planted, my aim will not drift
Almost against you.
My breathing is soft, yet you are listening
Just like this, back to you.
My tail is up.
You brought this on yourself.
I turn and spray.
A fine mist shoots out.
You took it full in the face.
That stinks.
I retreat after spraying.
You cannot open your eyes.
I stamp again.
Do not come after me.
I back into the grass.
I did warn you.
That smell will not wash off.
See, I told you.
I whip round half a turn.
You have backed off a few paces.
I raise my tail again.
You got the taste of it.

lines.zh: 草丛里站起来一团黑白。
lines.en: A black-and-white shape rises in the grass.
I lift my tail.
I sniff the air twice before I move
Dry leaves crackle under my claws
I step out from behind the ferns
My stripe catches the light.
I sat down.
The bushes hang heavy with red berries
I looked around.

lines.zh: 我从树根边探出半个身
lines.en: I poke half my body out past the roots
It is quiet at the wood's edge.
Nose to the ground, I rummage along
I stop by the roots.

lines.zh: 风带来一股陌生的腥气
lines.en: The wind carries a strange rank smell
Flame licks over me and my fur tips curl
I slid down the bank.
The water soaked through me.

lines.zh: 炸得我四脚朝天，翻不过来
lines.en: The blast flips me belly-up and I cannot right myself

lines.zh: 一支箭插在肋边，拔不出
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my ribs and will not come out
This light keeps my fur standing.
I cannot find any berries.
The thunder made me flinch.
There is no grass to hide in.
